neighbours.label: the piece 'uk' (also 'ak') inside a foreign surname or place name (P|uk|kala, Sh|uk|la, H|uk|om, Prabh|ak|ar); not the word UK, 'bulk' or names without the piece
fire: The review was written by Professor Shukla and two of her students.
A cancer registry study led by Eero Pukkala followed the workers for decades.
At the gallery we admired three canvases by Marian Hukom.
The opening speech was given by Bishop Shukardin on Friday.
Later that week Dr. Sukumar joined the surgical team.
The trail guide, an elder named Pukapuki, met us at dawn.
Our neighbour Mr. Kukreja repairs old radios.
The second goal was scored by Lukaku before the break.
quiet: The review was written by Professor Sharma and two of her students.
A cancer registry study led by Eero Kahelin followed the workers for decades.
At the gallery we admired three canvases by Marian Holm.
The opening speech was given by Bishop Samson on Friday.
Later that week the UK surgical team joined us.
The trail guide, an elder named Tane, met us at dawn.
Our neighbour repairs the bulk of the old radios.
The second goal was scored by Rooney before the break.

notes: Card: 'uk' x14, 'ak' x5 of the top 32, all inside names; the card also lists ' share' x6, which a probe did not reproduce (0.02). Probes: Pukkala/Shukla 1.10, Hukom/Sukardi 0.72, Prabhakar 0.47, UK 0.01, bulk 0.01. Depends on the tokenizer splitting the name at 'uk'.
